### 1.2 Data Preparation and Pre-Processing

```{r, exploration.1, fig.height = 14}
source("settings.R")
source("source_all.R")

data <- read_excel("data/raw/Latte.xlsx")
setDT(data)

data <- data[, .(Farm, Month, Season, Year, `Log CBT`, `Log SCC`, `Risk - IBR`, `Risk - AGAL`, `Risk - PT`)]
colnames(data) <- c("Farm", "Month", "Season", "Year", "LogCBT", "LogSCC", "RiskIBR", "RiskAGAL", "RiskPT")

dt_analysis <- na.omit(data)

dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[, c("RiskIBR", "RiskAGAL", "RiskPT") := .(as.factor(RiskIBR), as.factor(RiskAGAL), as.factor(RiskPT))]

levels(dt_analysis$RiskIBR) <- c("Low risk", "Medium risk", "High risk")
levels(dt_analysis$RiskPT) <- c("Low risk", "Medium risk", "High risk")
levels(dt_analysis$RiskAGAL) <- c("Low risk", "High risk")

dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[, Season := as.factor(Season)]

levels(dt_analysis$Season) <- c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")

dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[, Year := factor(Year)][, YearNum := as.numeric(Year) - min(as.numeric(Year))]

quantSCC <- quantile(dt_analysis$LogSCC, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)
quantCBT <- quantile(dt_analysis$LogCBT, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)

dt_analysis <- dt_analysis[, c("SCCbins", "CBTbins") := .(cut(LogSCC, breaks = quantSCC, include.lowest = TRUE), cut(LogCBT, breaks = quantCBT, include.lowest = TRUE))]

dt_year <- dt_analysis[, .(meanLogCBT = mean(LogCBT), meanLogSCC = mean(LogSCC)), by = .(Year, Season)][order(Year)]
dt_month <- dt_analysis[, .(meanLogCBT = mean(LogCBT), meanLogSCC = mean(LogSCC)), by = .(Year, Month)][order(Year, Month)]

plot <- ggplot_longitudinal(dt_analysis, save = TRUE)
plot
```
